method: front identity master + corrected isolated shoulder profile + authored leg topology; no rejected side source and no 3D generation

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / controlled cross-view mechanical reconstruction. Create ONE corrected full-body RIGHT SIDE VIEW of the EXACT Social Brave King in Image 1, facing image LEFT. Image 1 is the authoritative whole-body identity, proportions, armor parts and color master. Image 2 is the corrected SIDE topology of its shoulder/bomber/engine, not a new torso: carry those orientation and separation rules into the full-body. Image 3 is a simple authored LEG construction guide: use its segment separation and forward axis, but take ALL actual detailed armor styling from Image 1, not the guide's simplistic shapes. Do NOT use or invent an older whole-body side drawing. SINGLE TRUE LATERAL ELEVATION, camera perpendicular to body side, eye level at waist with orthographic projection, no three-quarter foreshortening, no second view or inset. Left = front for head, chest cockpit, engine intake, fists, knee drill and toes. Preserve Image 1's tall approximately nine-crowned-head humanoid silhouette, long thighs/lower legs, massive orange/ivory steel fists, silver upgraded head crown with long flowing orange/ivory mane, blunt cockpit bomber chest, ivory/graphite/orange armor partitions, train-arm shell and drill-crawler lower legs. Do not fatten into a squat tank or make the head huge. MECHANICAL LOCKS: (1) The near bomber wing runs laterally toward the side-view camera, so only its THIN CHORDWISE EDGE is visible above the shoulder, as Image 2; no large triangular top surface, bird-like pauldron or vertical fin. It is connected through its separate orange/graphite root bracket. The bomber engine is an actual forward-facing cylinder, with intake at LEFT and nozzle at RIGHT: show the cylinder side wall and only a narrow intake rim; NO ROUND FAN DISK FACING VIEWER. Keep the original ivory core shoulder cap and black shoulder joint BELOW the engine. The root carrier, engine and arm shoulder are three distinct assemblies, no fan replacing a shoulder. Match Image 2's front/back orientation, but retain Image 1's more compact blunt chest nose depth and chest shape. (2) The leg is thigh, black round knee joint, forward-projecting steel KNEE drill, armored CALF with its external vertical crawler module, an articulated ANKLE, then a separate armored BOOT. Use the same faceted ivory shin plates, orange mounts, graphite wheel hubs and black tread pads as Image 1. The calf crawler must STOP before the ankle; it must NOT grow into a continuous giant tank belt around the entire foot. Show clear ankle articulation/gap and separate ivory upper boot armor. Keep a moderate heavy foot with graphite toe block, orange toe inset, short heel, low sole tread detail. NO enormous triangular track slipper, NO one-piece excavator leg, NO new tracks on thigh. Knee drill axis and toe axis both point LEFT. Preserve full leg length and calf bulk from Image 1. (3) The single undersea train was split into two arm sections; the near section stays on the OUTSIDE of the reinforced forearm. Its rounded cab/nose end points BACK toward elbow (RIGHT); split midsection sides form an open cannon jacket around the forearm; the large real fist extends FORWARD from its front opening, knuckles LEFT. No tiny complete train sitting above arm, no train at shoulder. Draw a naturally lowered arm with slight elbow flexion; do not rotate the fist to show its front to the camera. The far arm/leg are mostly occluded in a pure side view, not spread for display. Keep source parts; no added weapons or armor inventions. Clean KINETIC_CEL model-sheet rendering, crisp ink, two-level cel shadow, broad material blocks and restrained highlights on warm ivory. Full hair, crown, wing edge, knee drill and feet inside frame with comfortable margin. No words, letters, arrows, guide lines, symbols, logos or poster graphics. The object is one consistent machine viewed from another direction, not an alternate redesign.
